phases.objective: Persist and consume one verified Separate Mount Authorization exactly once with generation and row-version CAS plus an immutable receipt.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Mount Authorization Registry Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: One verified authorization is durably registered, consumed exactly once by a bound executor and mount attempt, and read back with an immutable receipt before any mount may begin.
steps: Verify the canonical Separate Mount Authorization and its active evidence window.
Register the exact authorization bindings under a shared advisory lock and row transaction.
Reject divergent replay, expired evidence, binding drift, and stale generation.
Consume generation N to N+1 with executor and mount-attempt bindings.
Insert and read back one immutable consumption receipt in the same transaction.
assertions: Factory creation performs no database connection.
Only the canonical authorization digest, operation, plan, runtime, and generation can consume the record.
A second consumption and automatic retry are rejected.
No mount, dependency injection, route mutation, worker call, provider call, migration, or Production mutation occurs.
The raw SQL pool and credential material are not exposed.

phases.objective: Promote and apply the contract-local schema, then compose the registry into a separately authorized mount executor.
blockers: The two registry tables remain contract-local DDL and are not promoted or applied.
No live signed schema verification exists for the registry tables.
The Authorized Mount Executor is not yet composed or mounted.

phases.objective: Fail closed on expiry, stale generation, concurrent CAS changes, duplicate or orphan receipts, and any binding or readback mismatch.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Hostinger Storage Durable Mount Authorization Registry Guard
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Concurrent or repeated consumption rolls back without a receipt, while the first exact consumption remains immutable and non-retryable.
steps: Lock the authorization row and any existing receipt.
Compare authorization, operation, plan, runtime, generation, consumed state, and row version.
Reject a CAS miss or an existing receipt and roll back.
Preserve the original row or the single successful receipt exactly.
assertions: Generation increases by exactly one on the only successful consumption.
The receipt is append-only and uniquely bound to authorization and mount attempt.
A failed CAS leaves both current row and receipt state unchanged.
No automatic retry or mount side effect is available.
